caption: Sacra di San Michele, Sant'Ambrogio di Torino
composition: Romanesque-Gothic abbey perched on Monte Pirchiriano above the Susa Valley · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist looks up at the abbey crowning its rocky pinnacle center-frame, the great stone church with its tall bell tower rising above sheer cliffs. A long staircase and massive buttress descend along the right flank toward the forest, while the Susa Valley spreads left under layers of hazy blue mountains. At 11:00 the sun is high and the air crystalline, with only wisps of cloud in the blue sky.
